manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration and gravitational force remain fully active.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side panels show a vertical ball toss and its corresponding velocity-time graph with live readouts and vectors.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings at the top.
